## Code

```{r}
blm_colorado <- read.csv("~/samuelson-hickman_test/blm_colorado.csv")
```

## Remove Unneeded Columns and Add Activities Columns

```{r}
blm_colorado_2 <- blm_colorado |>
  mutate(address = str_c(Address_1, Address_2, sep = " "),
         )|>
  select(-X)|>
  group_by(Phone_Number)|>
  mutate(ContactRegion = cur_group_id())|>
  ungroup()

listed_activities <- c("CAMPING")

# Create a new column for each word
for (word in listed_activities) {
  blm_colorado_2 <- blm_colorado_2 |>
    mutate(!!word := as.integer(str_detect(blm_colorado_2$Activities, word)))
}

```
